about_the_game:
CHAQS 44 is not just a simulation; it is a fully equipped, living operating system designed for those who love to push boundaries, manipulate digital ecosystems, and rewrite the rules.

Featuring a command-line terminal built on real-world logic, a comprehensive cyber forensics software suite, and an interactive desktop where you can manipulate every cell of the system... CHAQS 44 doesn't hand you a linear script; it hands you a system. What you do with it is entirely up to you.

A Terminal That Breaks the Fourth Wall

The terminal isn't just a collection of fake, in-game commands. While the challenges and objectives are meticulously crafted within the simulation, certain terminal commands communicate directly with the real world. Use actual network logic, execute real web-based queries, and fetch live data to solve complex in-game problems. The skills and logic you learn in this system will still be relevant when you close the screen.

Challenges & Hidden Objectives

You are not just wandering in an empty sandbox. Step into meticulously designed challenges that demand genuine curiosity, logical deduction, and out-of-the-box thinking. Solve complex cryptographic puzzles, uncover hidden data trails, and breach secure networks. There are no waypoints or hand-holding—only your intellect, the terminal, and the truth waiting to be uncovered.

Master the Complete Terminal Arsenal

Your terminal is your ultimate weapon. CHAQS 44 features a deeply integrated shell with a massive library of functional commands built for real-world logic:

  • File & Data Management: cd, ls, pwd, locate, mkdir, rm, trash, cp, mv, rename, touch, stat, file, cat, tac, head, tail, find, tree, count, du, df, wherefrom, fragment, duplicate, scrub, shredmap, unzip, import, export

  • Networking & Remote Exploitation: nmap, portscan, netstalk, ssh, scp, ftp, smbclient, ping, traceroute, whois, hydra, dirbuster, enum4chaqs, curl, wget, submit, nc, ipconfig, ip, netjam, disconnect

  • Cryptography & Forensics: nyx, steg, hashid, john, hashidentifier, pgp, vault, invert, hexdump, bininspect, binwalk, strings, detect, compileinfo, exifsm, timeline, license, verify, checksum, correlate

  • System Administration & Identity: sudo, su, adduser, deluser, usermod, groups, passwd, chmod, chown, umask, whoami, id, who, last, ps, kill, uptime, shutdown, sysinfo, uname, envexport, man, mandb, whatis, apropos, history, save, cloud

  • Data Processing, Signals & Logic: grep, sort, wc, diff, echo, amorse, audiodecoder, dtmf, sqlclient, alias, calculate, numbers, converter, linq2chaqs, permutations, base, imager, translate, brainf, piet, whitespace, xclip, yes, passrate

  • Environment & Interface Management: qrsm, clear, art, ink, hexmorph, palette, thumb, screenshot, setwallpaper, neeko, familiar, stacks, synapse, mousemove, cal, date, cowsay

Execute On-the-Fly Code with Nexcode

Need to test a logic gate, process a string, or solve a mathematical cipher? Open Nexcode, your native in-game code execution environment. Write and instantly run code snippets in C#, C++, Python, Lua, Ruby, and JavaScript directly within the OS. It is the perfect sandbox for executing rapid algorithms and processing data without ever leaving your terminal workflow.

Your Advanced Cyber Forensics Arsenal

All the native software a real expert would need to analyze targets, dissect data, and uncover hidden truths is integrated directly into the core of CHAQS 44:

  • Native Reverse Engineering: Dissect binary files and debug system-level errors.

  • Shark: Capture packets (PCAP) passing through your network in real-time and map the anatomy of network traffic.

  • ByteSentry: A professional hexadecimal editor for low-level data manipulation and byte-level file inspection.

  • Spectra: Detect and manipulate steganographic data and encrypted text hidden within images.

  • Ripper & Voxelium: Force-open secured archive packages and directly visualize/edit 3D voxel-based digital assets within the system.

  • Regex44: Classify and parse complex data dumps in milliseconds with an advanced Regex editor.

Protect and Customize Your Ecosystem

To control the system, you must monitor it. Perfect CHAQS 44's modular desktop architecture to fit your exact workflow:

Import Your Reality: Bring your own local files—music, videos, and pictures—directly into the CHAQS 44 ecosystem. Listen to your own tracks in the native media player or analyze your personal images.

Privacy Guard: Isolate your system from external threats with a background-running, real-time tracker blocker.

Live Performance & Utilities: Turn your desktop into a command center with live CPU/RAM usage widgets, direct Wikipedia access modules, and much more.

Total Control: Make the OS your home with dynamic backgrounds, custom keyboard shortcuts, terminal color schemes (Color Inspector), and drag-and-drop window management.

CHAQS 44 is a playground for curious minds, a laboratory for security enthusiasts, and an interactive masterpiece written for those who love getting lost in the depths of a system.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / Debian 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R7 240
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Fedora 38
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible
